title: Darwin Core flat occurrence record (passive acoustic monitoring)
description: JSON Schema for flat DwC occurrence records, e.g. BirdNet-style acoustic detections. All DwC terms are strings per the Darwin Core Text Guide; detection metadata (start/end time, confidence, thresholds) is nested in dynamicProperties as a JSON string.

dynamicProperties.description: Must itself be valid JSON. Recommended keys for acoustic detections: start_time, end_time, confidence, experimental_threshold, preliminary_threshold, final_threshold.
dynamicProperties.$comment: JSON-level nesting cannot be enforced by JSON Schema on a string; parse it in a follow-up step (see scripts/validate.js or validate.py).

occurrenceID.description: dwc:occurrenceID - unique identifier of the record, e.g. file + time offset.

eventID.description: dwc:eventID - identifier of the sampling event, e.g. the audio file.

eventDate.description: dwc:eventDate - ISO 8601 date or datetime, YYYY-MM-DD (optionally with time).

eventTime.description: dwc:eventTime - time of day, HH:MM:SS(.sss)? with optional timezone.

scientificName.description: dwc:scientificName - full scientific name, ideally with authorship appended.

taxonRank.description: dwc:taxonRank - taxonomic rank of the scientificName.

basisOfRecord.description: dwc:basisOfRecord - controlled vocabulary of Darwin Core classes.

recordedBy.description: dwc:recordedBy - names of people or software that recorded the occurrence, e.g. the detection model name/version.

locationID.description: dwc:locationID - identifier of the sampling location.
